subject: Optimize Toolkit — Efficiency options & commercial terming for Quantify.ai
messages:
From: Gregor Novak <gregor.novak@quantify.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@quantify.ai
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Optimize Toolkit — initial RFP and performance goals

Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Quantify.ai is very interested in the Optimize Toolkit for our inference layer. We attached a short RFP with our baseline traffic (attached: Quantify_RFP_Q1_2027.pdf). High level asks:

- Target 95th p95 token latency under 150ms for our chat workloads (avg seq len ~128).
- Cost sensitivity: we anticipate 30–50M tokens/month after ramp; looking for options to keep unit costs predictable.
- Preference for a mix of batching + prefix KV caching; some models will require 8-bit quantization at inference.

Could you share recommended packaging approaches for a pilot (3 months) and what commercial levers you typically offer (credits, percent discount, committed tier)?

Timeline: procurement wants a draft commercial term sheet by 2027-01-15 if possible.

Thanks,
Gregor
Head of Infrastructure
Quantify.ai

Attachment: Quantify_RFP_Q1_2027.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB)
From: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
To: Gregor Novak <gregor.novak@quantify.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 11:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Optimize Toolkit — initial RFP and performance goals

Gregor —

Appreciate the RFP and the clear targets. High-level response below; attaching a starter term sheet (optimize_term_sheet_v1.pdf) that maps technical options to commercial levers. Quick summary:

1) Pilot structure (3 months)
   - Pilot SKU: Dedicated pilot cluster with autoscaling up to 4x baseline.
   - Efficiency controls: prefix KV caching enabled per-session (recommended for chat); aggressive KV eviction for low-cost routes.
   - Quantization: per-model quant profile — recommend dynamic int8 for stateless models and 4-bit constrained quant for LLM chat models that tolerate it.

2) Commercial levers we propose for pilots
   - Efficiency Credit: one-time pilot credit (applied against usage) sized to offset estimated per-token delta from baseline.
   - Commitment discount: 6% base off list when committing 6 months; larger for annual.
   - Conditional rebate: additional credits if latency SLOs are met for the pilot period.

3) Recommended technical guardrails (to preserve quality while saving cost)
   - Per-model prompt templates with quantization safeties (fall back to full precision for trigger patterns).
   - KV prefetch thresholds to avoid cache over-eviction.

Next steps: if that aligns, I can send an updated term sheet that splits the concession into (a) pilot credits and (b) a conditional rebate tied to p95 latency and accuracy checks. Kimberly (cc) will help attach specific numbers based on your usage sample.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Field Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: optimize_term_sheet_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 85KB)
From: Gregor Novak <gregor.novak@quantify.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Optimize Toolkit — initial RFP and performance goals

Markus — thanks for the quick outline. A few clarifying asks from procurement/infra:

- On quantization: can you describe the expected accuracy delta for the 4-bit constrained profile vs dynamic int8 on our representative workloads? We attached a small usage sample for the models (usage_sample.csv).
- On credits vs discount: procurement prefers a mix where at least 40% of the concession is an on-bill discount (so it shows up in ARR math) — is that something you can accommodate?
- Any operational differentiators (e.g., cold-start behavior when KV cache misses under burst) that would affect SLO attainment?

If you can get a redline-ready term sheet and a DocuSign link by 2027-01-15 we can accelerate routing through procurement.

Regards,
Gregor

Attachment: usage_sample.csv (text/csv, 12KB)
From: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, camila_reyes@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Optimize Toolkit — initial RFP and performance goals (internal)

Kimberly / Camila — forwarding Gregor's asks + our starter term sheet. Two internal proposals below — need your quick input so I can finalize a redline: 

Option A (credit-forward):
- Pilot credit: $40k one-time (applied to first 3 months).
- Commitment: 6% off list with a 6-month min; conditional rebate (up to $10k credits) if p95 < 150ms and accuracy regression < 1.5% during pilot.
- Rationale: credits keep list unchanged for ARR reporting but give near-term runway for customer to ramp.

Option B (split discount):
- On-bill discount: 3.5% applied for first 6 months (counts toward ARR).
- Pilot credit: $25k one-time.
- Conditional rebate: $7.5k credits tied to SLO.
- Rationale: procurement prefers ARR-visible concessions — this mirrors that ask while preserving some credits for ops.

Technical asks for product: for the 4-bit constrained profile we should produce a short accuracy delta table against their usage_sample.csv (sample-based A/B). Camila, can your team run a quick quant smoke test and give us expected delta and recommended fallback triggers?

If both agree, I'll push a revised term sheet with the split numbers and a DocuSign link.

— Markus

Subject: Final: Optimize Toolkit — updated commercial and efficiency plan

Gregor —

Appreciate the turnaround — attached is an updated term sheet (optimize_term_sheet_v1b.pdf) that implements Option B (split concession) and adds two items you asked for:

- Quantization guidance: we ran a targeted smoke test on your sample. Expected mean accuracy delta for the 4-bit constrained profile is ~1.1% (95% CI 0.7–1.6) vs full precision; dynamic int8 shows ~0.5% delta. We include fallback triggers: if a model inference returns a confidence delta >1.8% on the monitoring set we automatically route that call to full precision.

- Commercial split: 3.5% on-bill discount for the first 6 months + $25k pilot credit applied to month 1–3. Conditional rebate up to $7.5k credits if latency and accuracy SLOs are met.

- Operational notes: to avoid cold-start p95 spikes we recommend an initial warm-up plan (prefetch top 100 active KV prefixes during ramp) — we'll run that as part of onboarding.

If that looks good I'll generate a DocuSign (link below) and route to procurement. Proposed sign-off timeline: 2027-01-18 to meet your procurement window.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/parts/QNTFY-2027-001
Drive term sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cDriveLinkForTermSheet

Best,
Markus Klein
